checks.name: fresh installation has no website access
functional fixture uses byte-identical JS with test-only pre-granted hosts
real content script detects supported formats and inline-split text; skips excluded content
actual pointer hover opens live countdown tooltip
original text, inline markup and link handlers are preserved
dynamic insertions and changed time text update highlights
actual popup per-site switch removes current-page highlights
global disable unregisters scripts and removes existing highlights
re-enable registers exactly once without duplicate content injection
large page retains 5000 paragraphs and detects all 100 times
only preferences are persisted; scanned page content stays in memory
no external network requests or page errors observed

limitations: Production manifest default/no-access state is verified. Native optional-permission accept/cancel dialog UI is not automated; functional UI/content checks use byte-identical JS and a separate test-only manifest with pre-granted hosts. Permission removal is covered by unit tests.
